ask: Which of my hooks exist only to make sessions remember things, and which could filing-at-once replace?
note: Builds on rules you already have (output-answer-has-a-home, never drop an item silently) and on fb:. Once filing is reliable, some remember-guards can be retired in a later cull.
title: File it the moment it's said
why: Guards that make a session remember are a backstop. What actually works: anything that matters goes to a lasting home (a repo file, a roadmap page) in the same turn it's said. A session's job is filing, not remembering, so a compaction or a lost session costs nothing.
